Walk_Loop.prompt: A person walks forward at a steady, relaxed pace, arms swinging naturally.

Crouch_Fwd_Loop.prompt: A person walks forward slowly in a low crouch, knees deeply bent, sneaking quietly.

Jog_Fwd_Loop.prompt: A person jogs forward at a steady pace, arms swinging naturally.

Sprint_Loop.prompt: A person sprints forward at full speed, leaning forward, arms driving hard back and forth.

Idle_Loop.prompt: A person stands upright in a relaxed idle, legs nearly straight, both feet planted flat about shoulder width apart and staying still, weight shifting slightly from one foot to the other, arms hanging loose at the sides a little away from the body, breathing calmly.

Talk_Loop.prompt: A person stands upright and relaxed, talking with someone in front of them, shifting their weight from one foot to the other, gesturing with one hand and then the other at waist height, and nodding as they speak.

Hammer_Loop.prompt: A person repeatedly hammers something on a table in front of them with a hammer in their right hand.

Lean_Loop.prompt: A person leans back against a wall with their arms crossed over their chest.

Chop_Loop.prompt: A person repeatedly chops wood with an axe held in both hands.

Jog_Stop.prompt: A person jogs forward, then comes to a stop and stands still.

Jog_Start.prompt: A person stands still, then starts jogging forward.

Swim_Tread_Loop.prompt: A person treads water in deep water, upright with the head and shoulders above the surface, legs slowly kicking and circling beneath in an eggbeater kick, hands sculling side to side in front of the chest, bobbing gently.

Swim_Fwd_Loop.prompt: A swimmer swims front crawl at the surface of the water, lying face down and horizontal with the body stretched out flat, legs straight and fluttering in small kicks from the hips, arms reaching forward over the head one after the other and pulling back under the body, head turning to the side to breathe every few strokes.

Swim_Dive_Loop.prompt: A swimmer swims breaststroke underwater, lying face down and horizontal, both arms reaching forward together then sweeping out and back to the thighs, legs doing a frog kick, gliding between strokes.
